core_obligations: Right exactness (proof lines 2357-2358): sheafification is a left adjoint, hence right exact.

Left exactness (proof lines 2359-2369): the companion results identify the indexing categories of the colimits in the plus construction with directed sets, so filtered colimits commute with finite limits and the plus construction commutes with finite limits as a functor on presheaves; the statement for sheaves follows because limits of sheaves are computed as presheaves.
proof_roadmap: Use the adjunction for right exactness.
Identify the colimits in the plus construction as directed and apply commutation of filtered colimits with finite limits.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that sheafification commutes with finite limits (statement lines 2350-2354). The proof is a complete argument: right exactness holds because sheafification is a left adjoint (proof lines 2357-2358); the companion results identify the colimits in the plus construction with colimits over directed sets, so the plus construction commutes with finite limits as a functor on presheaves (proof lines 2359-2368); and the statement for sheaves follows since limits of sheaves are computed as presheaves (proof lines 2368-2369). The non-formal content is the recognition of the indexing category as directed. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
